name: bard
description: An experiential UX review of a running web app. Uses the app in a real browser through Playwright MCP as named personas (first-time, power user, keyboard-only, mobile, low vision, or your own), one area at a time, across seven review lenses. Screenshots every defect, reads the console and network for silent failures, and writes a ranked report where every finding has steps to reproduce, a screenshot, a severity and a suggested fix.
